description: This file provides configuration helpers for authentication, including environment variable parsing, validation, and tenant resolution logic. It defines functions to retrieve and validate secrets and salts, and to resolve tenant identifiers based on request headers and environment settings.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the tenant salt configuration from environment variables, ensuring it is URL-safe base64-like.

methods.name: getJwtSecretConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and checks the JWT secret from environment variables, indicating if it is missing or weak.

methods.name: getPasswordSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the password salt from environment variables, indicating if it is missing or a placeholder.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and allowlist/mapping validation based on environment variables and request headers.
